Description: The validation-preview path reports schema_validation as passed based on local field checks rather than executing the DEL-16-01 JSON Schema. The focused test envelopes omit schema-required fields such as operation_contract_status and provenance and include fields outside the schema such as target_ref and structured_values, yet they can produce a generated preview. This bypasses the canonical schema boundary required by PKG-02.
ProposedDisposition: Technically addressed: preview now runs Draft 2020-12 validation against schemas/model_operation.schema.json and reports schema_validation=blocked with OP-SCHEMA-VALIDATION-FAILED unless the canonical schema validates.

Description: Unit validation checks only that quantity payloads contain value, unit, and dimension keys. It does not compare dimensions against the target field or invoke a dimensional-analysis contract before marking unit_validation as passed.
ProposedDisposition: Technically addressed within accepted PKG-02 scope: quantity payload dimensions are validated against the accepted canonical dimension vocabulary and unknown dimensions block unit_validation; deeper target-field dimensional compatibility remains outside this DEL-16-02 finding-resolution slice.

Description: The preview engine accepts arbitrary accepted_model_state mappings and derives entity identity from loose keys without checking canonical physical_source_of_truth model role, schema-governed state shape, or required current hashes before previewing changes.
ProposedDisposition: Technically addressed: preview blocks accepted states without physical_source_of_truth role, missing current state hash, model-basis hash mismatch, or missing/stale operation required_current_hashes; preview output includes the accepted model-state hash reference.
